caption: The video captures a sunlit street intersection from a fixed sidewalk position, with a striped crosswalk and short bollards lining the edge and a V-shaped marking in the asphalt. A dark pickup is parked at the left, a white van in the middle distance. Dense trees and parked cars fill the background under a bright, partly cloudy sky with sun glare. A traffic-signal pole at the right shows an illuminated green light; the overhead head stays unlit. Throughout the excerpt a dark sedan creeps rightward from the left edge, its front advancing across the crosswalk while its rear stays cut off by the border. An orange traffic cone rests beside the van, its position unchanged. The bollards, crosswalk, pickup, trees, and sky hold their positions, confirming a stationary camera.
